RadioGroup.name: disabled
RadioGroup.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

RadioGroup.name: readOnly
RadioGroup.description: Whether the user should be unable to select a different radio button in the group.

RadioGroup.name: required
RadioGroup.description: Whether the user must choose a value before submitting a form.

RadioGroup.name: name
RadioGroup.description: Identifies the field when a form is submitted.

RadioGroup.name: form
RadioGroup.description:
Identifies the form that owns the radio inputs.
Useful when the radio group is rendered outside the form.

RadioGroup.name: value
RadioGroup.description:
The controlled value of the radio item that should be currently selected.

To render an uncontrolled radio group, use the `defaultValue` prop instead.

RadioGroup.name: defaultValue
RadioGroup.description:
The uncontrolled value of the radio button that should be initially selected.

To render a controlled radio group, use the `value` prop instead.

RadioGroup.name: onValueChange
RadioGroup.description: Callback fired when the value changes.

RadioGroup.name: inputRef
RadioGroup.description: A ref to access the hidden input element.

RadioGroup.name: className
RadioGroup.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

RadioGroup.name: style
RadioGroup.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

RadioGroup.name: render
RadioGroup.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
